/oc is --prompt a global flag? What about the other ones? Where are the global flags defined? Consider adjusting the docs to match the correct real truth

No, `--prompt` is NOT a global flag. Based on my analysis of the code: **Global flags (only these are truly global):** - `--help` (alias `-h`) - `--version` (alias `-v`) - `--print-logs` - `--log-level` **Command-specific flags:** - `--prompt` (alias `-p`) - Only available in the TUI command - `--model`, `--agent`, `--port`, `--hostname` - Available in specific commands but not global The documentation was incorrectly listing command-specific flags as global. I've updated it to show only the actual global flags and moved the TUI-specific flags to the TUI command section where they belong.
